pages.title: Storage Actuator
pages.text: The $(item)Dimensional Storage Actuator$() consists of a $(l:crafting_rituals/craft_dimensional_matrix)Dimensional Matrix$(/l) inhabited by a $(#AA00AA)Djinni$() that creates and manages a storage dimension,$(br) and a $(l:crafting_rituals/craft_storage_controller_base)Base$(/l) infused with a $(#AA00AA)Foliot$() that moves items in and out of the storage dimension.$(br)

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: Place the $(item)Dimensional Storage Actuator$() and $(bold)right-click$() to open it. The terminal includes a $(bold)3x3 crafting grid$(). With JEI installed, recipe transfer fills available costs from your main inventory, then storage. Missing costs stay empty; transferring $()

pages.title: Safety first!
pages.text: Breaking the storage controller will store all contained items in the dropped item, you will not lose anything.$(br) The same applies to breaking or replacing Storage Stabilizers (you will learn about these later).$()

pages.title: Safety first!
pages.text: $(br2) $(br) Like in a shulker box, your items are safe!$(br)

pages.title: So much storage!
pages.text: A fresh controller has $(bold)128 storage slots$(), holding up to $(bold)1024 items per slot$() by default. Stabilizers add slots. One item type may fill several slots; damage and NBT can keep variants separate. Total capacity follows these slot limits, not a separate $()

pages.title: Unique Items
pages.text: Items with unique properties ("NBT data"), such as damaged or enchanted equipment will take up$(br) one item type for each variation. For example two wooden swords with two different damage values$(br) take up two item types. Two $()

pages.title: Unique Items
pages.text: wooden swords with the same (or no) damage take up one item type.$(br)

pages.title: Configurability
pages.text: Change base slots, stabilizer bonuses, per-slot capacity and normal stack-size handling in the storage section of $(bold)config/occultism.cfg$(). These are Forge 1.12 settings, not a per-world TOML file.

pages.title: Interaction with Mods
pages.text: For other mods the storage controller behaves like a shulker box, anything that can$(br) interact with vanilla chests and shulker boxes can interact with the storage controller.$(br) Devices that count storage contents may have trouble with the stack $()
